title: Whisker’s AI-powered litter robot thinks my cats swapped bodies
summary: The $899 Litter-Robot 5 Pro is a great pooper-scooper wrapped in AI that just doesn’t work. Whisker currently has four models: the Litter-Robot Evo, the Litter-Robot 4 , the Litter-Robot 5 , and the 5 Pro.
